title: eludite.terminal.read input
description: Read a terminal as text. `mode: screen` (default): the visible grid, one line per row, trailing spaces trimmed, with the cursor. `mode: since`: everything the terminal printed after `mark` (from eludite.terminal.send, eludite.terminal.wait or an earlier read), as plain text with escape sequences removed: the output of the commands run since. `mode: scrollback`: the last `max_lines` lines of the scrollback and screen. Every answer carries the `mark` to pass next time. Always allowed for agents (class read); also what ends the refusal of eludite.terminal.send after the person interrupted your wait.

terminal.description: The terminal: its id from eludite.terminal.open or eludite.terminal.list (`term1`, `term2`, ...). Default: the active terminal of the Terminal window (the one last opened or selected).

mark.description: With `mode: since`: where to start. Default: your last eludite.terminal.send's mark, else the start.

max_lines.description: With `mode: scrollback`: how many lines, from the end (default 200, at most 10000).
